first_checkup.title: How to prepare for your first medical check-up
first_checkup.excerpt: A short guide to help you feel confident and prepared for your very first comprehensive medical examination.

sections.heading: Better care starts with being prepared
paragraphs: Before your first medical check-up, it's important to collect your medical history, list any current medications, and note symptoms you've experienced recently. This helps your doctor build a complete picture and focus on what matters most to your health.

sections.heading: What to bring to your appointment
paragraphs: Arriving prepared saves time and ensures a smoother conversation with your doctor.
listItems: A list of all medications, including supplements and vitamins.
Previous lab results or reports if you have them.
Questions you want to ask your doctor.

sections.heading: During the check-up
paragraphs: Your doctor will usually check your vital signs, discuss your lifestyle, and perform a physical examination. Be honest about your habits and concerns — this is the best way to receive care that truly fits your situation.
Regular check-ups are the foundation of preventative medicine. By catching potential issues early, you give yourself more options, more time, and better outcomes.
